tools.name: get_business_info
tools.description: Return general info about this business: name, tagline, website, and contact details. Use to introduce or summarize the business.

tools.name: get_contact_info
tools.description: Return the contact details for this business: phone, email, and address. Use when the user wants to call, email, or visit.

tools.name: get_page_content
tools.description: Get the full readable text content of a page or post by its slug. Use after search_posts/search_pages to actually read a result, or when the user asks what a specific page says.

slug.description: The page or post slug, i.e. the last part of its URL path, e.g. "about-us".

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Get details for a single product by its slug. Returns name, price, URL, and short description if available.

tools.name: list_recent_posts
tools.description: List the most recently published blog posts on this site, newest first. Use when the user asks what's new or latest.

limit.description: How many posts to return, default 5, max 10.

tools.name: search_pages
tools.description: Search this site's static pages (about, services, contact, etc.) by keyword. Returns up to ten matches with titles and URLs.

query.description: Keyword or phrase to search for.

tools.name: search_posts
tools.description: Search this site's published blog posts by keyword. Returns up to ten matching posts with their titles and URLs.

query.description: Keyword or phrase to search for.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search this WooCommerce store's products by keyword. Returns up to ten matching products with name, price, and URL.

query.description: Keyword or phrase to search for.

limit.description: Max products to return, default 5, max 10.

tools.name: search_site
tools.description: Search this site for posts and pages by keyword. Loads the WordPress search results page.

tools.name: submit_footercontactform
tools.description: Submit the "Footer Contact Form" form on this page. Field purposes are described on each input.
